data.summary: Finance MBA with 5+ years of progressive experience in fund accounting, NAV operations, and financial reporting across private equity, real estate, and digital asset (crypto) fund structures — core disciplines directly transferable to hedge fund and alternative investment fund administration. Currently supporting Goldman Sachs Asset Management's real estate fund operations through a consulting engagement with Grant Thornton, preparing and reviewing NAV files, managing capital call processing and investor allocations, and supporting audit and due diligence. Proficient in Geneva, Investran, Lemon Edge, and Solvas. Known for sharp attention to detail, strong client and onshore team coordination, and a consistent record of driving process efficiency within tight SLA environments.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Finance MBA with 5+ years of progressive experience in fund accounting, NAV operations, and financial reporting across private equity, real estate, and digital asset (crypto) fund structures — core disciplines directly transferable to hedge fund and alternative investment fund administration. Currently supporting Goldman Sachs Asset Management's real estate fund operations through a consulting engagement with Grant Thornton, preparing and reviewing NAV files, managing capital call processing and investor allocations, and supporting audit and due diligence. Proficient in Geneva, Investran, Lemon Edge, and Solvas. Known for sharp attention to detail, strong client and onshore team coordination, and a consistent record of driving process efficiency within tight SLA environments.
